international.title: Blast on Russian ship in Benghazi a suspected drone attack, say Libyan authorities
international.summary: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia An explosion on a Russian ship docked at the naval base in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was caused by a suspected drone attack, Libya’s eastern-based government has said. There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the suspected strike, but it comes as Ukrainian forces have stepped up their long-range barrages against Russia far beyond the frontlines.
